title: psbt-spec adapter contract v1 (psbt-spec.adapter/1)
description: One JSON object per line. The evaluator writes hello_request and request lines to the adapter's stdin; the adapter writes one hello_response or response line to stdout for each. See docs/adapter.md.

id.description: Chosen by the evaluator, echoed by the adapter. 0 for hello, then 1, 2, ... in order.

task.description: A role operation. deserialize covers the General rules alone.

bips.description: BIP numbers. 174 stands for PSBT version 0 and 370 for version 2; the others are extensions (371, 372, 373, 375, 376, ...).

base64.description: A PSBT in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding.

protocol.description: The protocol the adapter speaks. The evaluator stops on any other value.

project.description: The implementation under evaluation, pinned for the report.

revision.description: Source commit, or firmware build when there is none.

adapter.description: The adapter program itself, when it is separate from the project.

tasks.description: Tasks the adapter answers. Vectors for any other task are withheld (NOT IMPLEMENTED).

bips.description: BIPs the project supports. A vector needing any other is withheld (NOT IMPLEMENTED).
Every BIP the vector exercises. The adapter enables these extensions and no others.

psbt.description: The PSBT the role is given. Every task except combine.

sources.description: combine only: the PSBTs to combine, in order.

verdict.description: accept: the project performed the task. reject: the project refused the PSBT. n/a: the adapter cannot pose this vector to the project. error: the adapter failed.

reason.description: Free text, recorded in the report.

rule.description: reject only, optional: the psbt-spec rule ID whose property made the project refuse, mapped from the project's own error, and only when that mapping is certain. Omit it otherwise. A refusal of an invalid vector counts as MATCH only when this names the vector's rule or is omitted (docs/report.md, Named rules).

psbt.description: accept only: the PSBT the project returned. Required for finalize and combine, optional for sign (enforced by the evaluator, which knows the task).
